positions.description: Incident Manage and access administration for Mainframe

positions.description: Administrator of systems to grant access to users.

positions.title: Access Administration
positions.description: Grant access for Client systems, Afni systems, troubleshoot access issues, create IDs, update new hires, promotions/demotions and terminations and help with Afni and Client audits regarding access

positions.title: Quality Consultant
positions.description: Monitor agents to ensure process and proceedures are being followed to help make business goal. Facilitate internal and client calibrations. Help out with special projects when clients need additional feed back. Work directly with Operation Managers regarding trending/behavior information, processes and behaviors, and overall goal of the project.

positions.title: Quality Consultant
positions.description:
Complete monitors on agents to ensure that Client expectation is being met as well as having a positive customer interaction.
Facilitate calibrations with coaches as well as Clients to ensure project goal is understood and Client processes are followed to meet that goal.
Work with Operations Managers to implement sales support regarding low and middle performers to help increase productivity.

Core Qualifications										
Proficient in Outlook, Microsoft Work, Excel and One Note
Experienced with trending behaviors and monitors
Trained in Verint and ACSS
Trained in LivePerson
Efficient meeting leader

positions.title: Customer Service Consultant
positions.description: Ensure customer's issues were resovled in a timely manner while be professional and personal on all levels of customer interactions.
